name: Database
description: SurrealDB access mediated by the kernel. Plugins never open a DB connection themselves; the kernel scopes every query to the active org.

capabilities.name: Query
capabilities.description: Read data with SELECT / graph queries. Maps to kernel command db::query.

capabilities.name: Mutate
capabilities.description: Create, update, or delete records. Maps to kernel command db::mutate.

capabilities.name: Transaction
capabilities.description: Run a batch of queries inside a single transaction.
